title: China's economic trajectory
summary:
Main
By Michalis Voutsinas
China's economic trajectory continues to be shaped by the interplay between structural transformation and the gradual rebalancing of a growth model historically anchored in investment and industrial production. The prolonged adjustment in the property sector and a measured recovery in household expenditure coexist with increasingly sophisticated manufacturing capabilities, technological upgrading and a competitive export base. The latest economic indicators point to an economy retaining considerable growth capacity, albeit with marked differences in momentum across sectors and sources of demand.
